MAJOR UPDATE (Version 2.0): This project has evolved from a standalone Fast Travel hack into a more comprehensive bundle of quality of life hacks.

This is ONLY for Digimon World 2003. It will NOT work on Digimon World 3.

Included Features:
* Fast Travel: (Original feature) Press X on the map to warp.
* Battle Speed-Up: Textbox culling to significantly reduce battle duration and overworld text scrolling.
* In-game Walkthrough: Access guidance directly within the game menus.

These hacks have been designed to feel as close to original game features as possible. 

Patching instructions:
* Use https://www.romhacking.net/patch/ or PPF-o-matic to apply the ppf patch to the .bin file of your rom
* xdelta files have also been included in case you have issues applying PPF patches

Note that one combined patch file and three separate patch files have been provided, in case you would like to only use one or two of these hacks rather than all together.

Fast Travel
How to use it:
* Press X on an icon on the map to select it. When you completely exit the menu you will load into the selected area.
* Press Square while on the map to switch between server maps. If you haven't been to any Amaterasu areas then this map will be empty.

Post game notes:
* This will allow you to escape the post game area limit and get back to the original game.
* This is considered a feature rather than a bug as it allows some farming of otherwise inaccessible enemy Digimon.
* All NPCs won't show up if you are in an inaccessible area.
* Going underground or underwater in these areas in post game will crash the game (both are fine in the main game).

Battle Speed-Up:
This hack removes many redundant text boxes such as 'Agumon Attack!' etc.
It also will auto close other important text boxes after a few seconds such as how much damage was dealt.
It will not auto close text boxes that show when a new move is learned or an item is gained.
This significantly speeds up battles, and will save your thumb from mashing (and also accidentally mashing so hard you skip when you learn a tech/get an item).
As an addition (not part of battle text), speech bubble text scrolling will be auto skipped, meaning the full text will show instead of needing to press X.

In-game Walkthrough:
This hack will tell you exactly where to go and what to do next. No more looking up external walkthroughs when you get stuck.
Open the main menu in the game to see it.
Only the main story is included, no side quests and no post game.
Credit to markisha64 for reverse engineering the quest system, and to EmeraldPhoenix on GameFAQs for his walkthrough (this is based on his).
